# Timing chain and guide wear

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Inspect the gasket on the rear timing chain cover and seal any blown-out sections. [t990]

[Partial] Inspect timing chain guides for wear and note how much material has worn away. [t871]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Inspect the gasket on the rear timing chain cover for oil channel leaks.
2. [Partial] Ensure any blown-out sections of the gasket are sealed to prevent future guide wear.

_Procedure reported by [t990]._

## Tips & gotchas

- Note that some vehicles with over 200,000 miles may have no issues while others fail early. [t871]
